description: Build a walk-forward validation framework on top of a backtest engine for a parameterized BTCUSDT MA crossover strategy, using rolling train/test windows with separate in-sample and out-of-sample reporting.
agent_prompt: Build a walk-forward validation framework in /workspace/src/ on top of a backtest engine for a parameterized MA crossover strategy on /workspace/data/BTCUSDT_1d_2021_2024.csv. The framework must (1) split the data into rolling windows with configurable train_size and test_size (default 365d / 90d), (2) for each training window, run a parameter sweep over fast in {5,10,20,30} and slow in {50,100,150,200} keeping fast < slow, (3) select the best (fast, slow) by training-window Sharpe ratio, (4) apply the selected parameters to the corresponding out-of-sample test window, and (5) aggregate OOS results across all rolling windows. Write outputs to /workspace/output/: walkforward_windows.csv (one row per window with train_start, train_end, test_start, test_end, best_fast, best_slow, train_sharpe, test_sharpe, test_return), aggregated_metrics.json (in_sample_sharpe_avg, oos_sharpe_avg, oos_total_return, oos_max_drawdown, overfitting_gap = is - oos), and a brief markdown report at /workspace/output/report.md explaining the IS-vs-OOS gap.

required_capabilities: Implement rolling-window data splitting with configurable train and test sizes
Build a parameter optimization loop that runs multiple backtests per training window
Apply optimal parameters to out-of-sample test periods
Aggregate and report in-sample versus out-of-sample performance separately
